title: Character voice
description: films/<film>/characters/<id>/voice.json: how a character sounds (D-036). Chosen once at casting and used for every line the character speaks; the director never names raw voices in a line. One or more voices are blended by weight, then speed and a small pitch step are applied, and each line is normalized to a speech loudness.

engine.description: Text-to-speech model family. chatterbox only if approved at voice casting (STEP-3 checkpoint 2).

voices.description: Voices to blend, each with a weight; weights are normalized to sum to 1.

id.description: A voice of the engine, e.g. 'af_heart' (Kokoro: language/accent letter, gender letter, name).

pitch_semitones.description: Pitch step applied after synthesis (raises pitch and formants together, like a shorter vocal tract). 0 = none.

expressiveness.description: How animated the delivery is, for engines that support it (chatterbox). Ignored by kokoro.

loudness_lufs.description: Integrated loudness each line is normalized to before mixing.
